title: Quantitative ANC performance and latency acceptance are absent
description: The product requires low-latency real-time FxLMS and mentions a preliminary band in the architecture figure, but no complete attenuation, phase, latency or acoustic acceptance mask is frozen. This constrains architecture and feasibility claims.

evidence.note: No complete quantitative ANC acceptance mask is given.

closure_criterion: Product owner and controls/acoustic lead approve a measurable operating band, attenuation/latency target or a clearly bounded prototype envelope, plus conditions and measurement method before R3 architecture freeze; physical performance remains unproven until EVT.
